channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Lil Durk murder-for-hire trial goes to jury as prosecutors allege revenge, defence argues reasonable doubt
item.description: Lil Durk’s federal murder-for-hire trial has gone to the jury after prosecutors argued the rapper sought revenge over King Von’s killing, while his defence attacked the government’s evidence and urged jurors to find reasonable doubt.

item.title: Ukraine Hits Two Gas Condensate Plants in Russia’s Arctic
item.description: Ukraine said its hit two gas condensate processing plants in Russia’s Arctic zone for the first time, underscoring the expanding reach of Kyiv’s attacks on the nation’s key industry.

item.title: Emergency slide deploys on Qatari-gifted Air Force One, briefly delaying Trump before Dallas GOP convention
item.description: President Donald Trump’s departure for the GOP convention in Dallas was briefly delayed after an emergency slide deployed on his Qatari-gifted Air Force One. Trump said crews were carrying out a check and insisted he was confident the aircraft was safe.

item.title: Iran Nuclear Impasse Deepens After US Wins UN Watchdog Vote
item.description: The US pushed through a resolution of censure against Iran that refers its nuclear file to the United Nations Security Council, deepening the diplomatic divide separating Washington from Beijing, Moscow and Tehran.

item.title: ChatGPT 1980s photo trend: Shashi Tharoor and sons join AI fashion; netizens react, ‘More handsome than Shah Rukh Khan’
item.description: Shashi Tharoor shared photos from the 1980s on social media, drawing comparisons to Bollywood stars. Many users praised his timeless charm and retro style.

item.title: Coal India steps up output, supplies to power plants as rains subside
item.description: Despatches from Coal India's mines to the power sector rose 27% to 1.74 million tonnes on 8 September, from an average of 1.37 million tonnes a day during the first three days of the month, the state-run miner said.

item.title: JPSC scam: ₹5 lakh for PT, ₹25 lakh for final clearance, blank cheques and more — how alleged syndicate ran in Jharkhand
item.description: Former JPSC Chairman L Khiangte's bail petition was rejected. Reportedly, the CBI, which is currently probing the alleged exam irregularities in the Jharkhand case, submitted an affidavit.&nbsp;

item.title: ChatGPT 1980s photo trend: What happens to your picture after you upload it?
item.description: A new ChatGPT trend allows users to create retro 1980s-style selfies. Before uploading, users should consider the privacy implications, as images can contain personal data. Uploaded photos may be stored with conversation data, raising questions about data retention and usage by AI services.

item.title: Who is Noel Clarke? British actor charged with six sexual offences involving five women
item.description: Actor and filmmaker Noel Clarke has been charged with six sexual offences, including sexual assault and voyeurism, following allegations from five women. The alleged offences date from 2007 to 2016. He is due in court in October.

item.title: 'Moonlighting is a crime unless you're an MP': LinkedIn post sparks debate; check social media reactions
item.description: A LinkedIn post discusses society's ‘double standards’ on moonlighting, contrasting employees' additional income with MPs' outside professional engagements.&nbsp;

item.title: Who is Suresh Gopi? Why did BJP MP and Malayalam star order all gates at Thrissur’s Paliyekkara toll plaza to be opened?
item.description: Suresh Gopi highlighted ‘legal guidelines’ after directing toll plaza operators to open all gates at Paliyekkara. According to police, the traffic cleared in half an hour after the gates were opened.

item.title: Ammy Virk's father dismisses Canada Shooting ‘rumours’ involving his son, says family safe and no dispute with anyone
item.description: A vehicle linked to a Punjabi concert tour in Canada's Abbotsford was shot at, raising questions about whether Ammy Virk was targeted. His family denied he was involved. Initial reports claimed he was in the bulletproof vehicle.

item.title: Monsoon to remain active across India through 15 September
item.description: Southwest monsoon accounts for more than 70% of India's annual rainfall, while about 45% of the country's net sown area remains rain-fed.

item.title: Global Fintech Fest 2026: PhonePe becomes first app to enable Visa's tokenisation, tap to pay and cross-border payments
item.description: PhonePe and Visa have launched three payment solutions—Tap to Pay, Cross Border Scan to Pay and Smart Accept—at GFF 2026. PhonePe becomes the first Indian app to offer Visa’s three core capabilities, while Smart Accept lets small merchants accept card payments using smartphones.

item.title: Mint Explainer: Will Volkswagen be third time lucky with an Indian partner?
item.description: Following failed tie-ups with Tata and Mahindra, Volkswagen has turned to JSW to cut production costs as the Indian conglomerate seeks European tech to diversify from Chinese partners.

item.title: Aadhaar prepares for threefold jump in daily authentications: UIDAI chief Neelkanth Mishra
item.description: UIDAI chairperson Neelkanth Mishra said Aadhaar is preparing for a sharp rise in usage, with daily authentications expected to increase from 100 million to 250-300 million.

item.title: CAQM pulls up Haryana pollution board over dust-monitoring lapses
item.description: The Commission for Air Quality Management (CAQM) has flagged a lack of compliance by the Haryana State Pollution Control Board in monitoring construction sites. The CAQM highlights failures in remote dust control measures as air quality concerns rise ahead of winter.

item.title: CNR Rao name mismatch hearing: Did Bharat Ratna scientist receive SIR notice over extra 'F'? GBA chief clarifies
item.description: GBA Chief Commissioner Maheshwar Rao clarified that no notice was served on Professor CNR Rao regarding the electoral roll revision. According to the GBA, Rao was listed as a voter in Part No-129, Serial No-431 of the 76-Malleshwaram Assembly Constituency in the 2002 electoral roll.

item.title: ChatGPT photo trend: Top 5 prompts to turn your photo into 1960s, 70s, 80s and 90s versions for Instagram, WhatsApp
item.description: ChatGPT photo trend: A photo trend is going viral, turning people's pictures into nostalgic moments from the 80s. Here's how you can create yours too in easy steps using ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Grok and other AI photo-editing tools.

item.title: Rhiya Ahir, Shehzad Poonawalla spar over Bigg Boss 20, Rahul Gandhi and age: ‘Leave women alone’
item.description: Riya Ahir, a Mumbai model, responded to Shehzad Poonawalla's mockery about Bigg Boss 20 by sarcastically defending herself and criticising his age difference. She denied disrespecting the Army and dismissed political claims against her, urging Poonawalla to focus on people closer to his age.

item.title: Punjabi singer-actor Ammy Virk's convoy attacked in Canada: 7 shots fired, no injuries reported — What we know so far
item.description: Punjabi singer-actor Ammy Virk was reportedly caught in a shooting in Canada after his concert in Abbotsford. Police said 7 shots were fired at a vehicle, with no injuries. Virk's father has said the singer is safe.

item.title: India condemns Iran-backed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that injured over 70 civilians: 'Unacceptable'
item.description: Ministry of External Affairs spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal said such aggressive actions that “undermined regional security and stability and threatened freedom of navigation in the Bab-el-Mandeb were unacceptable”.

item.title: Gaurav Bhatia files ₹2 cr defamation suit against Saurav Das, other CJP leaders over AI-generated post
item.description: BJP leader and senior advocate Gaurav Bhatia has filed a defamation suit before the Delhi High Court against CJP, its leaders Abhijeet Dipke and Ashutosh Ranka, and Saurav Das over alleged defamatory social media posts.

item.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Dates, venue, timings and complete itinerary
item.description: The BRICS Leaders' Summit is scheduled to be held at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi on September 12-13 at Bharat Mandapam. The official theme for this year is “Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability”.

item.title: BRICS Summit 2026: Will New Delhi be shut? Uber, DTC buses, road closures, airport routes, emergency services — 10 FAQs
item.description: . Will the entire Delhi remain closed during the BRICS Summit 2026? Here are some key questions answered by the Delhi Traffic Police that will make your travel from September 11 to September 13 hassle-free amid restrictions.

item.title: Muslim man’s skullcap pulled off in Uttar Pradesh, six youths face police action – What we know
item.description: The incident took place during a procession organised to mark the birth anniversary of Rani Veerangana Avanti Bai Lodhi in the Marhara police station area last week, the police said.

item.title: One dead, four injured after oxygen cylinder explodes in Delhi's Okhla
item.description: The incident was reported around 11 am. Three water tenders and a multi-casualty first responder vehicle were rushed to the spot after the incident.

item.title: ‘How can magistrate issue notice?’ Why CJI Surya Kant questioned notice to Noida student over Jantar Mantar protest
item.description: Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant questioned how the executive magistrate could issue such a notice when the top court has earlier directed that no penal action would be taken against students.

item.title: Delhi Satya Niketan building collapse: PG operator arrested, adjacent unsafe building demolished | Top updates
item.description: Delhi Police have arrested one of the PG operators, Sudhanshu, while the other one is on the run in a case related to the collapse of a PG facility in the Satya Niketan area of the city. Seven people, including five students, lost their lives when the building came crashing down on 6 September.

item.title: Who was Rakesh Mehta? Former Delhi chief secretary hangs self, leaves 'suicide' note, family says he was unwell
item.description: Former Delhi Chief Secretary Rakesh Mehta, 74, was a 1975-batch IAS officer. He had served under former Delhi Chief Minister Sheila Dixit for over three years - from 2007 to 2010.

item.title: World’s highest-paid Prime Minister just got a 60% raise. Who is Lawrence Wong, and how much does he earn?
item.description: Lawrence Wong announced that he plans to donate the entire increase in his salary

item.title: UK air traffic control fault disrupts over 1,000 flights, airlines call for reform; Air India issues advisory for flyers
item.description: A technical fault at UK air traffic control provider NATS disrupted over 1,000 flights, with cancellations and delays at major airports. Air India said it had to divert, delay or cancel multiple UK flights and advised passengers to check flight status.

item.title: ₹17 Crore PNB fake currency case: NIA arrests bank manager – how did the scam come to light?
item.description: The National Investigation Agency has arrested Amit Kumar, an absconding bank employee and key accused in the alleged conspiracy involving counterfeit Indian currency notes with a face value of ₹17.29 crore recovered from a Punjab National Bank currency chest in Saharanpur, Uttar Pradesh.

item.title: Congo’s Ebola Crisis Spurs IMF to Consider Pandemic Financing Reforms
item.description: The International Monetary Fund is considering making pandemic preparedness reforms part of its financing program for the Democratic Republic of Congo, as the country’s worsening Ebola epidemic exposes weaknesses in how it funds and responds to health emergencies.

item.title: Mumbai traffic advisory: Slow vehicular movement expected in BKC today over Global Fintech Fest; check alternate routes
item.description: Traffic authorities alerted motorists that vehicular flow will be particularly slow between 4:00 PM and 8:00 PM
